featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience with Dr. Prasad Rane at this clinic.
I initially went for a root canal followed by capping. After the procedure, there was a noticeable gap left between two of my teeth (tooth 6 and 7), which was not addressed at the time. Within a few weeks, I started facing discomfort and had to revisit.
Instead of fixing the root cause, the doctor simply filled the gap with temporary material. There was no acknowledgment that the capping may have been done incorrectly. Unfortunately, this did not solve the problem, and I continued to face issues.
After a few months, I went back again, but the approach remained the same — temporary fixes(one of them where he was ready to shave off my lower tooth which was completely healthy)and general suggestions, without any permanent solution.
Later, I consulted another dentist, who pointed out that the filling shouldn't been done (the filling which dr Pradeep did was inside the gums, between the teeth). I was told that this is not recommended practice, as it can cause gum impingement and inflammation — which I was indeed experiencing.
Overall, I ended up spending a significant amount of money without getting a proper resolution. The repeated temporary fixes, lack of accountability, and questionable treatment approach left me feeling that the issue was not handled with the required level of care.
I would strongly advise others to seek a second opinion before proceeding with similar treatments here. I have a photo from another doctors consultation.

1️⃣ Brush Twice Daily
Brush your teeth two times a day using fluoride toothpaste to remove plaque and bacteria. Good oral hygiene helps prevent cavities and tooth decay.

2️⃣ Floss Daily
Flossing helps clean areas between teeth where a toothbrush cannot reach and reduces the risk of cavities and gum problems.

3️⃣ Avoid Too Much Sugar
Sugary foods and soft drinks can increase tooth decay and cavities. Try to limit chocolates, cold drinks and sticky foods.

4️⃣ Drink More Water
Water helps wash away food particles and keeps your mouth fresh and clean throughout the day.

5️⃣ Visit Your Dentist Regularly
Regular dental checkups help detect cavities early and keep your teeth healthy. Professional teeth cleaning also helps maintain oral hygiene.

6️⃣ Use Fluoride Toothpaste
Fluoride strengthens tooth enamel and protects your teeth from cavities and sensitivity.
